value.rationale: Completes the minimal finite-direction and direction-configuration problem for a natural full ellipsoid model in geometric tomography. Even observing each entire section function and knowing the total volume does not reduce the universal view requirement from d(d+1)/2. The exact optimal view design and simple Lipschitz inversion give usable finite-acquisition benchmarks; the global equal-volume obstruction is stronger than dimension counting.
